parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

parameters.name: ConsumerAppIds
parameters.description: The ID of the custom application.

parameters.name: DubboMockItems
parameters.description: Specifies the project in the recycle bin.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the mock rule. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled.

- `false`: disabled.

parameters.name: MockType
parameters.description:
Specifies the response time (RT) of a slow call. Valid values:

- 15: 15 ms

- 30: 30 ms

- 60: 60 ms

- 120: 120 ms

parameters.name: ProviderAppId
parameters.description: The ID of the provider application.

parameters.name: ProviderAppName
parameters.description: The name of the provider application.

parameters.name: ScMockItems
parameters.description: The input parameters. The value must be a JSON string.
